title: AutoLayoutRequest
description: Body of POST /api/dashboards/:id/auto-layout (HEL-367, breakpoint-aware since HEL-1071) — packs the supplied panel sizes into non-overlapping {x,y,w,h} positions (left-to-right shelf-flow, input order = visual order) and persists them. Without `breakpoint`, EVERY breakpoint is packed independently at its own column count (lg 12, md 10, sm 6, xs 2): `items[].w` is in `cols` units (default 12) and is scaled to each breakpoint, so no item can overflow xs. With `breakpoint`, only that breakpoint is packed (`w` in its own units, `cols` if supplied must equal its column count) and the others are untouched. Panels on the dashboard but omitted from `items` keep their current saved position in each packed breakpoint and the packed items are placed below them. A `panelId` not belonging to the target dashboard, or a result that is out of bounds/overlapping (e.g. omitted panels already overlap), rejects the whole request with 400 and saves nothing.

cols.description: Column count `items[].w` is expressed in. Defaults to 12 (lg) when omitted; at most 12. With `breakpoint`, must equal that breakpoint's column count.

breakpoint.description: Pack only this breakpoint and leave the others untouched. Omit to pack every breakpoint at its own column count.
